verses.text: Listen to me, you islands. Pay attention, you nations far away. The LORD called me before I was born. While I was still in my mother's womb, he spoke my name.
He made my words like a sharp sword. He hid me in the shadow of his hand. He made me like a polished arrow and hid me in his quiver.
He said to me, "You are my servant, Israel, through whom I will show my glory."
But I said, "I have worked for nothing. I have used up my strength for nothing and with no result. Yet what is due to me is in the LORD's hand, and my reward is with my God."

And now the LORD speaks, the one who formed me in the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob back to him and gather Israel to himself. For I am honored in the eyes of the LORD, and my God has been my strength.

He says, "It is too small a thing for you to be my servant only to bring back the tribes of Jacob and restore the survivors of Israel. I will also make you a light for the nations, so that my salvation may reach to the ends of the earth."

This is what the LORD says, the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel, to the one who was hated by people and rejected by the nation, to the servant of rulers: "Kings will see you and stand up. Princes will see you and bow down, because of the LORD, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you."

This is what the LORD says: "At the right time I answered you. On the day of salvation I helped you. I will keep you safe and make you a covenant for the people, to restore the land and to give out again the land that was left empty.
You will say to the prisoners, 'Come out!' and to those in darkness, 'Come into the light!' They will feed beside the roads and find pasture on every bare hill.
They will not be hungry or thirsty. The desert heat and the sun will not hurt them. For the one who has mercy on them will lead them, and guide them to springs of water.
I will turn all my mountains into roads, and my highways will be raised up.
Look, they will come from far away, some from the north, some from the west, and some from the land of Aswan."
Shout for joy, you heavens! Celebrate, you earth! Burst into song, you mountains! For the LORD comforts his people and has mercy on his suffering ones.
But Zion said, "The LORD has left me. The Lord has forgotten me."
"Can a mother forget the baby at her breast and have no love for the child she gave birth to? Even if she could forget, I will never forget you!
Look, I have written your name on the palms of my hands. Your walls are always in front of me.
Your children are hurrying back, and those who destroyed you and ruined you are leaving.
Look up and see all around you. All your children are gathering and coming to you. As surely as I live," says the LORD, "you will wear them all like jewels. You will put them on like a bride.
Your land was ruined, empty, and destroyed. But now it will be too small for all your people, and those who swallowed you up will be far away.
The children born during your time of sorrow will say to you, 'This place is too small for us. Give us more room to live.'

Then you will say to yourself, 'Who gave birth to all these for me? I had lost my children and could have no more. I was sent away into exile and wandered about. Who raised these children? I was left all alone. Where did they come from?'"

This is what the Lord GOD says: "Look, I will lift my hand to signal the nations. I will raise my flag for the peoples. They will carry your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their shoulders.

Kings will take care of your children, and their queens will nurse them. They will bow down before you with their faces to the ground and lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD. Those who hope in me will never be disappointed."
Can the prey be taken away from warriors, or captives be rescued from a fierce ruler?
But this is what the LORD says: "Yes, captives will be taken away from warriors, and prey will be rescued from the fierce. I will fight those who fight you, and I will save your children.

I will make those who treat you cruelly eat their own flesh. They will be drunk on their own blood, as if it were wine. Then all people will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob."
